the development of an appropriate multicast handover supporting mechanism for mobile nodes executing FMIPv6 based handovers.
the design, evaluation and comparison of multicast handover mechanisms, aiming to provide a seamless experience to the recipients of multimedia multicast traffic.

the FMIPv6 extensions proposed in this paper enable the execution of seamless multicast remote subscriptions during inter-domain handover procedures.
